_comment: Fetch scope. Copy to gmail-allowlist.json and fill in (the real file is git-ignored). fetch_query: which mail to fetch; the default is everything received, including mail a filter archived past the inbox. exclude_labels: label ids to skip entirely, without classifying.
_exclude_labels_hint: Use label ids (GET /gmail/v1/users/me/labels), not display names. Parent and child labels have separate ids; list each one.
